basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 29-year-old teacher from San Diego who recently started exploring the world of Reddit. When I'm not in the classroom, I love learning about new hobbies like swordsmithing and exploring the great outdoors at places like San Onofre Nude Beach. I'm not very tech-savvy, so I often find myself seeking help on subreddits like pcgamingtechsupport. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, and I'm currently in a committed relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in education, specifically teaching middle school history and social studies. I have a Bachelor's degree in Education, and most of my computer knowledge comes from basic classroom tech training and self-teaching when issues arise.
